# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
We currently support and patch security issues for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | ✅ (active)        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you find a security vulnerability in this project, please report it through one of the following:

- Use **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting** (recommended).  
- Or email us at: security@sdkassociates.com.au  

Please include:
- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Possible impact

We will review the report within **3 business days** and aim to provide a fix within **14 days**, depending on severity.
